rubric.accept: Accept only when every criterion is satisfied for the complete Skill package and its responsibility boundary.
rubric.correct: Require professional correction when any criterion exposes an error, material omission, responsibility gap, or unverifiable output.

criteria.adjacent-overlap-or-gap: Adjacent Skills have neither material responsibility overlap nor an uncovered gap.
criteria.boundary-conditions: Material edge cases and authority boundaries are explicit.
criteria.erroneous-rules: No misleading, unsafe, obsolete, or internally conflicting rule remains.
criteria.failure-modes: Triggered failure modes and recovery limits are covered.
criteria.generic-knowledge-pollution: The package excludes generic knowledge that does not justify context cost.
criteria.material-omissions: No material expert decision, failure mechanism, or operational obligation is missing.
criteria.output-verifiability: The output contract produces reviewable, verifiable evidence.
criteria.professional-correctness: Rules and decisions are professionally correct for the named capability.
criteria.reference-high-risk-coverage: Indexed References cover the high-risk decisions delegated by the root Skill.
criteria.verification-methods: Claims and outputs have proportionate verification methods.
